name: reborn-phase-rule-main-confirm
question: On borg-reborn-rs main 3ba17e2c (the rule shipped off), does #584's Phase Door rule at the 100 percent threshold (thr-100) die less than ctl, on 1,800 fresh starts (classes-1800-b)?
description: On borg-reborn-rs main 3ba17e2c (the rule shipped off), does #584's Phase Door rule at the 100 percent threshold (thr-100) die less than ctl, on 1,800 fresh starts (classes-1800-b)? Generated from definitions/reborn-phase-rule-main-confirm.yaml: 2 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-main-3ba17e2c, suite classes-1800-b.
prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-19, before any result of these profiles was read. Confirmation of one prespecified test (RULES 8).
Same specimen and profiles as the pilot reborn-phase-rule-main-pilot (RULES 16). ctl is main's shipped rule (off);
borg-reborn-rs may ship the rule on later, and this run still measures it against off on 3ba17e2c.
Primary endpoint: death by the 100,000-turn cap among the 1,800 classes-1800-b starts, thr-100 against ctl, paired
on the same start; two-sided exact McNemar test at alpha 0.05. Confirmed helpful only if p < 0.05 and thr-100 has
fewer deaths. Pairs where either cell did not finish (stall, timeout, crash, harness or config error) are left out of
the test, listed and counted per arm (RULES 6), never relabelled as deaths or survivors.
Secondary endpoints (progress, non-inferiority): mean max CL and mean max DL, thr-100 minus ctl, paired on the same
start. thr-100 is non-inferior when the lower bound of the two-sided 95% paired interval (normal approximation) is
above -0.25 CL and above -0.10 DL. Development: +0.03 CL and -0.01 DL.
Descriptive only: CL1-3 deaths, deaths and causes per class (Druids and Mages named in advance: the development
study had Druids 19 against 12 and Mages 2 against 5 in its big tier), games identical to ctl, Phase Doors done and
"# Phase rule" verdicts.
Development study (classes-1800 on 4acf071f, 1,728 paired starts): ctl 93, thr-100 77 deaths (55 / 39, p 0.12).
Sizing: development discordance 94/1728 with a net 16/1728; the normal approximation gives about 40% power at 1,800
pairs if that effect holds. A result short of p < 0.05 does not show the rule has no effect.
Gate (before the test is read):
- no config_error; one binary; each arm's three #584 values in borg.txt;
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified and key outliers listed;
- in ctl, no "# Phase rule" note.
The result is reported in a RULES 18 bin (harmful, neutral or helpful); shipping the rule is the owner's call.
owner_authorization: 2026-11-19: after the development study on 4acf071f, the owner asked to file the suggested runs, the confirmation of thr-100 on current main among them. Dispatch is the owner's call.
